# Gerris Corp

> Gerris Corp is Chris Abraham's agency for technical SEO, site speed, Google Business Profile recovery, AI search visibility, and reputation management.
> Source: https://gerriscorp.com/ · Last updated: 2026-10-05

Technical SEO, Google Business Profiles, AI search, and online reputation. Hands-on work by Chris Abraham.

Gerris Corp makes websites and businesses easier to find, and keeps what people find about them accurate. I don't advise with platitudes and leave. I do the work myself, from the server to the copy.

I've built websites since 1994 and have followed Google's algorithm since it launched in 1998. Gerris has run campaigns for clients in more than 40 industries.

Book a 30-minute call (https://calendly.com/chrisabraham/30) or hire me on Upwork (https://www.upwork.com/freelancers/chrisjabraham).

## Services

### Technical and on-page SEO

Clean, crawlable site structure; fast pages; titles, descriptions, headings, alt text and structured data; redirects, canonicals and sitemaps; Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools set up properly. Organic search only: no black-hat link buying and no ads.

### Site speed

Image compression, caching, leaner CSS and JavaScript, CDN setup, and passing Core Web Vitals.

### Site migrations and 301 redirects

Moving platforms or restructuring URLs without losing the rankings you've earned. Includes 404 cleanup, internal linking, and disavowing toxic backlinks.

### Google Business Profile

Reinstating suspended profiles, setting up and verifying new ones, and ongoing management. Flat prices are below (https://gerriscorp.com/#gbp).

### AI search visibility

Making your content clear and citable for ChatGPT Search, Copilot, Google's AI answers, and the other AI tools people now ask instead of searching.

### Online reputation management

Shaping what shows up when people search your name or your company's: strategic content, search results you control, and help in a crisis. Discreet service for executives and other high-profile people.

### Platforms

WordPress, Drupal, Shopify, Squarespace, Wix, Webflow, Joomla, Umbraco, Plone, Movable Type, and hand-built static sites.

## Google Business Profile pricing

If your profile is suspended, missing, or was never set up, you're losing local leads. All work is paid in advance. Google has the final say on timing.
- Reinstatement: $500 flat. Diagnosis, audit, compliance fixes, and a full appeal. If I can't get your profile reinstated, you get your $500 back. Usually 5 to 14 days.
- New profile and verification: $500 flat. Set up correctly from day one. Usually 3 to 7 days.
- Optimization and protection: $500 flat. Categories, services, description, photos, NAP consistency, and defense against spam and fake reviews. 7 to 10 days.
- Ongoing management: from $350 a month. Weekly posts, review responses, spam cleanup, and reporting. The growth plan, at $750 a month, adds review campaigns and quarterly optimization. Cancel with 30 days' notice.
- Fast-track consultation: $250. A 30-minute strategy call, credited toward any later service.

Complex or multi-location cases may be quoted higher after a first look. I never fabricate evidence or misstate facts to Google.

## Questions

### What does Gerris Corp do?

Hands-on technical and on-page SEO, site speed work, site migrations, Google Business Profile reinstatement and management, AI search visibility, and online reputation management. Chris Abraham does the work himself.

### Can you get a suspended Google Business Profile reinstated?

Usually. Reinstatement is a $500 flat fee covering diagnosis, audit, compliance fixes, and a full appeal to Google, typically 5 to 14 days. If the profile is not reinstated, the $500 is refunded.

### Do you buy links?

No. Gerris Corp does organic search engine optimization only: better, faster, more complete sites with better content. No black-hat link building and no paid ads.

### Can you guarantee a number one ranking on Google?

No one honestly can. The goal is a large, lasting improvement in visibility. Most sites see significant improvement in 3 to 6 months, depending on the competition and the site's starting point.

### Which platforms do you work on?

WordPress, Drupal, Shopify, Squarespace, Wix, Webflow, Joomla, Umbraco, Plone, Movable Type, and hand-built static sites.

## About

Gerris Corp is run by Chris Abraham (https://chrisabraham.com/bio) from Arlington, Virginia, across the river from Washington, DC. Before Gerris, Chris was on the Interactive team at Edelman in Washington and was a technology strategist at New Media Strategies, an early online brand promotion and protection firm. He later led high-end reputation sales for Reputation.com. He has a BA from The George Washington University.

The name comes from Gerris lacustris, the common water strider.
